description:
Workspace sweep follow-up to bd:JMAP-qz9v.39 (contacts-server fixed in commit landing now).

The JMAP-hwdv epic promoted in-memory backend impls from tests/common/ to src/memory.rs across the extension-server family. Three sibling READMEs still describe the OLD layout in their Gotchas section:

1. **crate-jmap-sharing-server/README.md:212-214** — says 'in-memory MockBackend in the test_support module is a test harness only'. Actual: src/memory.rs gated behind feature='memory' (file exists, 38 KB). MockBackend is no longer the canonical name for the in-memory impl in this crate.

2. **crate-jmap-tasks-server/README.md:255-256** — says 'No storage backend ships with this crate. The memory feature is for tests/demos only.' Compresses too much: 'doesn't ship' contradicts 'memory feature'. Replace with the contacts-server pattern (positive description of feature='memory' + caveats list).

3. **crate-jmap-metadata-server/README.md:271-273** — says 'No storage backend ships with this crate by default. The memory feature provides...' Borderline — the 'by default' qualifier makes it almost-correct, but the lead-in 'No storage backend ships' is still misleading.

Recommended replacement text, mirroring the canonical-by-content pattern (see crate-jmap-filenode-server/README.md:239-246 which is already correctly shaped, and crate-jmap-contacts-server/README.md:262-269 after this bead's fix):

> **memory::MemoryBackend is a reference implementation, not production.**
> Gated behind feature = 'memory' (off by default). State is held in HashMaps
> behind a std::sync::Mutex; persistence is not implemented; a number of <RFC>
> edge cases are simplified. Intended for integration tests, smoke tests,
> examples, and as source-readable study material for downstream contributors
> writing a real (database-backed) backend. See the module docs in
> src/memory.rs for the explicit non-production caveats.

Doc-only fix; no code touched. P3 because the failure mode is reader misdirection, not runtime breakage.

Cross-references:
- Original bead: bd:JMAP-qz9v.39 (contacts-server, fixed in same commit as resolve_query_offset / as_nanos work)
- Promotion epic: bd:JMAP-hwdv
- Already-correct sibling: crate-jmap-filenode-server/README.md:239-246
title: README Gotchas: sweep stale 'MemoryBackend in tests/' / 'no storage backend ships' wording across siblings post-JMAP-hwdv
